findings.what: Ten teams that rose from 0.947/0.948/0.952 into 0.953 after 18:08 all appear at the very END of the 0.953 block (ranks 438-469). Their last submissions were 11:46-14:08 UTC. This fits late byte-copies of x138 sharing x138's exact unrounded score, with ties broken by the earlier submission (Rules 3.7.b; CONTEXT 13:58 UTC). The same thing happened in the 16:52->18:08 window (ranks 438-453). It is indirect support that the x138 block is mostly exact copies and that tie order among them is by time. A non-copy such as K2 is ordered by its unrounded score.
